subject: integration
name: Orivon's Swarm node
summary: The Swarm node Orivon runs on this computer, the default source of bzz:// content and of .eth names that point at Swarm. Open source. Every chunk is checked against its address and a feed's newest update against its signature, so a peer cannot change what a site is. Not private: the Swarm network sees this computer's address and the references it asks for, unless the tunnel for nodes is on. Judged here by its publisher.
